# GitHub Copilot repository instructions

Before making changes, follow the canonical instructions in [../AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) (repository-root `AGENTS.md`).

**Permanent branch restriction:** make all work directly on the existing `seo-app-at-root` branch. Never create, fork, rename, or switch to another branch. If the required branch is unavailable, stop and report the issue rather than creating another branch.

Do not deploy, push, merge, or change repository settings without explicit user approval.
